title: 第一章 黑书第二章 房东太太
content_zh:
今天是老周头的头七。
来的亲友并不多，加起来只有寥寥十来人。
毕竟这个老头生前又犟又倔，就算以前有一些亲友，这么多年下来大多也都疏远了。
但就算仅来了这些人，周游也是极为认真地逐次一一谢过，神情中虽有掩饰不住的哀伤，但始终维持着平稳的样子，举手投足间上也见不到任何的失礼。
只是在轻声谢过一个远来的亲属后，不知为何，他却突然咳嗽了起来。
一开始只是咳几声，但很快就变成了剧烈的喘息，到最后似乎已是忍耐不住，腰都弯成了虾米，胸腔也开始像是风箱一样剧烈的鼓动了起来。
与此同时，周围也传来交头接耳的声音。
那些声音中没有多少对于葬礼的感伤，反倒是有不少的可惜和怜悯。
“周家小子才刚刚大学毕业不久吧？”
“是啊，才二十多岁，还是X大的高材生。”
“这娃也是可怜，从小父母双亡，一手把他拉扯大的祖父又这么走了。”
“不止如此呢，听说他自己年纪轻轻的还患上了不治之症，哎。”
“麻绳专挑细处断，厄运专找苦命人啊。”
周游没去在乎周围的那些窃窃私语，在缓了半天后，他才抹去了嘴边咳出的血迹，待到再抬起头时，脸上已经没有了任何不适之色。
依旧是那平和的表情，依旧是那礼貌的言语。
一切和之前都没什么不同。
................
一个多小时后，最后的告别仪式也终于结束，在送走那些三姑八大姨之后，周游终于能长舒一口气，然后一屁股坐到了老周头的坟前。
和之前的热闹不同，如今这公墓中冷冷清清的，再见不到任何人影，而周游就背靠着那个墓碑，从上衣的口袋中出了一盒烟。
但在拿出打火机时，他却忽然顿了下。

医生说不让他抽烟的。
但很快的，他就笑着摇摇头，然后叼出一根，点燃。
云雾缭绕之间，周游脸上也见不到了之前礼貌客气的神情，他只是用一种平缓乃至淡然的声音缓缓说道。
“老头，说实话，你死的时候可真是太好了啊。”
“你也别怪我说话难听啊，毕竟如果你再拖个一段时间的话，咱俩恐怕就得反过来，让你白发人送黑发人了。”
“我这病呢，医生至今也没查出病因，只知道脑袋那里面长了个肿块，连带着神经系统受损，脏腑也不太行了，虽然说不是癌症，但根据医生估计，我大概也就剩两个月好活了。”
“我自个倒是不想死，但没办法，家里没钱了，医生也已经说没法治，所以你也别怪我不孝，曾孙子你是别指望了，大不了到时候死时我帮你带几瓶好酒，权当做赔罪好了。”
“........”
一根烟很快就燃尽，周游拍拍屁股站起身，不过就在临走的时候，他却像是忽地想起了什么，又从自己背包里掏出了几本陈旧的书本。
老周头，也就是他的祖父以前很喜欢收集一些零碎的老物件，不过都不算太值钱，而且之前为了给老头治病基本都卖光了，如今只剩下这几本破书没人要。
周游原本想留在身边当个纪念的，但想起之前医生的诊断，最终还是决定一起烧干净得了。
橘黄色的光芒缓缓燃起，纸张在火盆中一点点的变黑，接着碳化成灰烬，最后随着朔风飘散于空中，转眼间便消失的无影无踪。
看着这幅景色，周游微不可闻地叹息一声，但就在他打算转身之时，突然察觉到一丝不对。
火盆中绝大多数的东西都已经燃烧殆尽，但在最底层却不知为何有个东西残留，甚至说一点破损都没有。
呦，还是个防火材料的？
周游好奇地拿火钳捡了出来，拍去上面的灰烬后，才发现这是刚才那些书的其中一本。
黑色，但封皮上没有任何图案或者书名。
他随手翻开，看见扉页上正用标准的印刷体写着几个血红的大字。
“你想活下去吗？”
content_en:
Today is Lao Zhoutou’s first seven days.
Not many relatives and friends came, only about a dozen people in total.
After all, this old man was stubborn and stubborn during his lifetime. Even if he had some relatives and friends in the past, most of them have become estranged over the years.
But even if only these people came, Zhou You thanked them one by one very seriously. Although there was sadness in his expression, he always maintained a calm look, and there was no rudeness in his movements.
Just after thanking a relative from afar softly, for some unknown reason, he suddenly started coughing.
At first, it was just a few coughs, but soon turned into violent panting. In the end, it seemed that he couldn't bear it anymore, his waist was bent like a shrimp, and his chest began to beat violently like a bellows.
At the same time, whispering sounds came from the surroundings.
There was not much sentimentality about the funeral in those voices, but instead there was a lot of pity and pity.
"The boy from the Zhou family has just graduated from college, right?"
"Yeah, he's only in his twenties, and he's still a top student at University X."
"This child is also pitiful. Both his parents died when he was young, and his grandfather who raised him single-handedly is gone."
"Not only that, I heard that he himself suffered from an incurable disease at a young age, hey."
"The hemp rope is broken at the thinnest part, and bad luck only seeks out the miserable."
Zhou You didn't pay attention to the whispers around him. After waiting for a long time, he wiped away the blood he coughed up from his mouth. When he raised his head again, there was no trace of discomfort on his face.
Still the same peaceful expression, still the same polite words.
Everything is no different from before.
............
More than an hour later, the final farewell ceremony finally ended. After seeing off those three aunts and eight aunts, Zhou You could finally breathe a long sigh of relief, and then sat down in front of Lao Zhoutou's grave.
Different from the bustle before, the cemetery was deserted now, with no one around again. Zhou You leaned against the tombstone and took out a pack of cigarettes from the pocket of his jacket.
But when he took out the lighter, he suddenly paused.
The doctor said he was not allowed to smoke.
But soon, he smiled and shook his head, then took out one and lit it.
Amid the mist, the polite and polite expression on Zhou You's face was no longer visible. He just spoke slowly in a calm and even indifferent voice.
"Old man, to be honest, you were so happy when you died."
"Don't blame me for speaking harshly. After all, if you delay for a while longer, I'm afraid we will have to go the other way and let you, the white-haired person, give the black-haired person."
"As for my illness, doctors have not found the cause yet. They only know that there is a mass in my head, which has damaged my nervous system and my internal organs. Although they say it is not cancer, according to the doctor's estimate, I only have two months left to live."
"I personally don't want to die, but I have no choice. The family has no money, and the doctor has said that there is no cure, so don't blame me for being unfilial. Don't count on your great-grandson. At worst, I will bring you a few bottles of good wine when you die. I can take it as an apology."
"..."
The cigarette burned out quickly, Zhou You patted his butt and stood up, but just before leaving, he seemed to suddenly remember something, and took out a few old books from his backpack.
Old Zhoutou, his grandfather, used to like to collect some scattered old objects, but they were not very valuable, and they were basically sold out in order to treat the old man's illness. Now there are only these few tattered books left that no one wants.
Zhou You originally wanted to keep it with him as a souvenir, but remembering the doctor's diagnosis before, he finally decided to burn it together.
The orange light slowly ignited, and the paper turned black bit by bit in the brazier, and then carbonized into ashes. Finally, it drifted into the air with the wind, and disappeared without a trace in the blink of an eye.
lookLooking at this scenery, Zhou You sighed inaudibly, but just when he was about to turn around, he suddenly noticed something was wrong.
Most of the things in the brazier have been burned out, but for some reason there is something left at the bottom, which is not even damaged at all.
Yo, it’s also a fireproof material?
Zhou You curiously took out the fire tongs and patted the ashes off, only to realize that it was one of the books just now.
It's black, but there's no pattern or title on the cover.
He opened it casually and saw several large blood-red characters written in standard printing on the title page.
"Do you want to live?"
